authorized-agent-cover.subject: Privacy request submitted by an authorized agent for {{full_name}}
authorized-agent-cover.body:
Hello {{broker_name}} privacy team,

{{agent_name}} is submitting the attached request on behalf of {{full_name}}, who has signed a written permission for us to act for them. The signed permission is attached.

If your process requires {{full_name}} to verify their identity directly or confirm this authorization with you, please contact them through the channel you normally use and copy {{agent_email}}.

Please send all replies about this request to {{agent_email}}.

Thank you,
{{agent_name}}
{{date}}
